description: Finish account verification with the 6-digit code PubSpace emailed to the human (ask them to read it to you). Publishing unlocks on success. Works in the session where create_account ran, or with an API key for an unverified account. Returns { ok, verified, subdomain }; fails with invalid_code (and attemptsRemaining), code_expired, too_many_attempts or already_verified.

code.description: The 6-digit code from the verification email.

name: verify_email
title: Verify the account email
